chapters.title: Chapter 2461 The Infinite Hyperversal Haven! II
paragraphs: 2461 The Infinite Hyperversal Haven! II
"...Acclimate yourselves and work to procure these treasures that will elevate your Boundaries and Realms even further."
His voice was magnetic as with the effect of Hyperversal Dignity, it felt like a celestial being was calmly giving a command to the masses that rewired him!
He told them to go forth and obtain the bounty and wonder of the expanding Infinite Hyperversal Haven as the souls of these beings before him surged!
RAAA!
A terrifying cry came from an Emperor Penguin as it was the first to adhere to the command of its Master, others moving soon after as they were being dismissed to seek out wondrous boons for now.

Maximilian bowed towards Noah's visage respectfully as he moved back with the past powerhouses of the Lernaean Lineage, only a few existences being left behind as Henry came before Noah while his main body still buzzed with the changes brought about through the Quintessential Hyperversal Emperor Lineage.
"Father."
Henry's dark blue hair now carried traces of gold as he seemed like a much younger version of Noah, gazing at his father and the Dignity he gave off as Noah's hand came to land on his shoulder.
Father and son looked at each other with understanding and care as Noah replied.
"I can reforge your Realm into something I have in mind, but take some time to think about what realm you'd like to have yourself. Tell me after you've come to a decision."
He had calculated countless things in the illusory trillions of years as the possibilities of Realm Reconstruction were many!

Henry nodded at his father's words as he turned towards the expanding lights of singularities across the Infinite Hyperversal Haven, turning into a streak of light towards them as his eyes were hazy with thoughts on what he wanted his Realm to be.

The only beings left behind in the immediate vicinity came to be the Aeonic Soul Clones of Orion and Aurelia who were utterly perplexed at everything that occurred, Noah turning his head towards Orion as he spoke grandly.

"You and the other Lernaean Apex Aeonic Lifeforms will benefit greatly from the boons about to bloom in this Infinite Hyperversal Haven. Let them know they simply need to bend the knee and all of these resources will be available to them."

He spoke in such a manner towards an Apex Aeonic Lifeform, but it didn't feel wrong in any way with the pressure he released as Orion calmed from his shock and gazed at everything with a calculative gaze.
At the same time, Noah's eyes turned towards an inquisitive Aurelia as he spoke.
"And you...you made a promise to me for the entry into my forge. Let us now fulfill it."

Aurelia's eyes which seemed to be lost in thought blinked as she came to, nodding nonchalantly as to her, it also seemed she would get to ask her many questions about this being and how the things he was doing were possible.
"I don't know how much help I'll be in the elevation of your Realm when you've already done this much, but I will keep to my words. I also have many questions!"

Her curvaceous figure was draped in halcyon attire as she innocently moved towards Noah, her eyes twinkling with interest on how a being who hadn't even undergone Apexification could release the aura he was currently releasing!
Beside her, Orion was still thinking contemplatively as soon after, his gaze turned towards the direction where Henry had disappeared to.

Among the many things he thought about, there was the prominent sensation of a connection with the Scion of Noah Osmont, Orion very quickly connecting the dots that what he lost all those years ago must have been obtained by him.
The eyes he lost that allowed him to see much more.
He wanted to hear of how they had been and how they ended up in his hands as he turned into a streak of light towards where Little Henry had disappeared to!
"Ho? The time is actually coming!"
Euryale held a cruel smile as she had given a specific prompt to the Authority of the Prognostic Dynamis of Extremity.

As soon as the aura of the Apex Aeonic Lifeform left the periphery of the main body of the Lernaean Commander, Prognostic would alert her and she would make her move with confidence that nobody could save the Lernaean Commander with dark blue hair and those around him.

And the authority of Prognostic told her the distance between the aura of an Apex Aeonic Lifeform was getting further and further away as she prepared to make a move, her hand coalescing terrifying tendrils of a lethal Dynamis of Extremity as just when she was about to move...
She spat out with distaste as Prognostic told her the expanded distance between the main body of her target and the Apex Aeonic Lifeform reduced greatly again.
She stopped her movements as she waited once more.
She was patient.
She had a lot of time.
She simply wanted to know that when she made her lethal move, it would succeed with utmost surety!
Past the floating silver and crimson Obelisks within the Abyssal Sanctimonious Lands.
Past the fissure that opened from the Extremity Vein of Dissolution.
ROAAR!

The bellows of massive Leviathans of Dissolution could be heard as Scions crossed the fissure and into the wondrous domain within, their souls feeling an increased sense of pressure as they felt as if they stepped into a brand new plane!

There were dozens of titanic Leviathans of Dissolution obscuring their views, but the Scions could see a vast and endless heavenly space past the fissure as it didn't seem like there was a floor or ceiling in any direction.

It glimmered black, white, and gold as tendrils of Vein like trees arched across the radiant space shimmering with black, white, and gold, with these tendrils of veins having at their ends vibrant Golden Extremity Panaceas.
Some tendrils of veins in the far distance even held Extremity Panaceas that shone with an Obsidian glint!
This was only what they could see in the periphery as it was also very prevalent on some of the beautifully branching veins that...they had been plucked.
It meant the Leviathans of Dissolution before them had long since eaten from the fruits of these lands as they had forged their stupendous Foundations.
Surviving against them was something only the truly powerful Scions could do, or the cooperation of clusters of Scions!

Among the Scions coming in, the Leviathans of Dissolution roared out and charged forward without waiting as they defended their territory, Scions like Erikson, Ayame, and Atlas already engaging with their enemies as at this moment...a draconic Leviathan turned its majestic snake-like eyes towards a stellar existence that had not been targeted yet.
BZZZT!
The massive body of this Leviathan known as the Silver Striped Imoogi moved, its titanic body seeming like the size of a world compared to the restricted 2 meter size of most Scions here.

It barreled towards the form of the Quintessential Emperor of Extremity as it seemed like an ancient beast was about to swallow an insignificant being whole, and yet when the Silver Striped Imoogi was about to near...
Its body came to a halt right before Noah's most pristine Reified Source of Extremity.

The pride and majesty of the dragon Lineage burned in the Silver Striped Imoogi, and yet its pupils constricted in shock as the moment it neared and was about to act, the relatively small body of the being it targeted felt utterly massive and gave off waves of pristine Dignity!
A dignity that made even a Leviathan that had forged its Foundation stop as it felt like a primal beast was staring it down.
Noah's will stared at this Leviathan and the unfolding domain behind it as he made a move to ascertain something.
His Main Body could release an output of .1 Apex Aeonic Damage Value and defend against .33 with his Innate Barrier alone.
Now...his Reified Source of Extremity could display the capabilities of his main body in a range of multiples.
And the Reified Source of Quintessence...had the highest multiple amongst all of his Reified Sources of Extremity!
So...just what level of power could he truly unleash at this moment in time?!

sentences.text: 2461 The Infinite Hyperversal Haven!
II
"...Acclimate yourselves and work to procure these treasures that will elevate your Boundaries and Realms even further."
His voice was magnetic as with the effect of Hyperversal Dignity, it felt like a celestial being was calmly giving a command to the masses that rewired him!
He told them to go forth and obtain the bounty and wonder of the expanding Infinite Hyperversal Haven as the souls of these beings before him surged!
RAAA!
A terrifying cry came from an Emperor Penguin as it was the first to adhere to the command of its Master, others moving soon after as they were being dismissed to seek out wondrous boons for now.

Maximilian bowed towards Noah's visage respectfully as he moved back with the past powerhouses of the Lernaean Lineage, only a few existences being left behind as Henry came before Noah while his main body still buzzed with the changes brought about through the Quintessential Hyperversal Emperor Lineage.
"Father."
Henry's dark blue hair now carried traces of gold as he seemed like a much younger version of Noah, gazing at his father and the Dignity he gave off as Noah's hand came to land on his shoulder.
Father and son looked at each other with understanding and care as Noah replied.
"I can reforge your Realm into something I have in mind, but take some time to think about what realm you'd like to have yourself.
Tell me after you've come to a decision."
He had calculated countless things in the illusory trillions of years as the possibilities of Realm Reconstruction were many!

Henry nodded at his father's words as he turned towards the expanding lights of singularities across the Infinite Hyperversal Haven, turning into a streak of light towards them as his eyes were hazy with thoughts on what he wanted his Realm to be.

The only beings left behind in the immediate vicinity came to be the Aeonic Soul Clones of Orion and Aurelia who were utterly perplexed at everything that occurred, Noah turning his head towards Orion as he spoke grandly.
"You and the other Lernaean Apex Aeonic Lifeforms will benefit greatly from the boons about to bloom in this Infinite Hyperversal Haven.
Let them know they simply need to bend the knee and all of these resources will be available to them."

He spoke in such a manner towards an Apex Aeonic Lifeform, but it didn't feel wrong in any way with the pressure he released as Orion calmed from his shock and gazed at everything with a calculative gaze.
At the same time, Noah's eyes turned towards an inquisitive Aurelia as he spoke.
"And you...you made a promise to me for the entry into my forge.
Let us now fulfill it."

Aurelia's eyes which seemed to be lost in thought blinked as she came to, nodding nonchalantly as to her, it also seemed she would get to ask her many questions about this being and how the things he was doing were possible.
"I don't know how much help I'll be in the elevation of your Realm when you've already done this much, but I will keep to my words.
I also have many questions!"

Her curvaceous figure was draped in halcyon attire as she innocently moved towards Noah, her eyes twinkling with interest on how a being who hadn't even undergone Apexification could release the aura he was currently releasing!
Beside her, Orion was still thinking contemplatively as soon after, his gaze turned towards the direction where Henry had disappeared to.

Among the many things he thought about, there was the prominent sensation of a connection with the Scion of Noah Osmont, Orion very quickly connecting the dots that what he lost all those years ago must have been obtained by him.
The eyes he lost that allowed him to see much more.
He wanted to hear of how they had been and how they ended up in his hands as he turned into a streak of light towards where Little Henry had disappeared to!
"Ho?
The time is actually coming!"
Euryale held a cruel smile as she had given a specific prompt to the Authority of the Prognostic Dynamis of Extremity.

As soon as the aura of the Apex Aeonic Lifeform left the periphery of the main body of the Lernaean Commander, Prognostic would alert her and she would make her move with confidence that nobody could save the Lernaean Commander with dark blue hair and those around him.

And the authority of Prognostic told her the distance between the aura of an Apex Aeonic Lifeform was getting further and further away as she prepared to make a move, her hand coalescing terrifying tendrils of a lethal Dynamis of Extremity as just when she was about to move...
She spat out with distaste as Prognostic told her the expanded distance between the main body of her target and the Apex Aeonic Lifeform reduced greatly again.
She stopped her movements as she waited once more.
She was patient.
She had a lot of time.
She simply wanted to know that when she made her lethal move, it would succeed with utmost surety!
Past the floating silver and crimson Obelisks within the Abyssal Sanctimonious Lands.
Past the fissure that opened from the Extremity Vein of Dissolution.
ROAAR!

chapters.title: Chapter 2462 Humiliation! I
paragraphs: 2462 Humiliation! I
Silver Striped Imoogi.
A massive serpentine dragon whose body alone towered akin to a world before the Scions and the figures of all others!
It had lived for an unknown number of years as it expanded its concepts towards Extremity while surrounded by Dissolution.

It was wrapped within the Extremity Vein of Dissolution itself for all of its life and restricted to this region where it found others similar to it, their purpose only being to get stronger until ultimately, they could devour the Extremity Panaceas that bloomed from the branches of Dissolution!
Its will was refined by its dozens of Concepts of Extremity and further propelled towards the precipice after it swallowed an Obsidian Extremity Panacea!
Its scales shone with blinding silver and black grandeur as it was a ferocious beast from ancient times that should terrify others with its mere gaze alone.
So...why could it not proceed any further while staring at a single existence before it?!
Noah emanated a suffocating type of pressure towards any of those wishing to act against him, and this Leviathan of Dissolution couldn't bring itself to make a move as at such a juncture...
"Come on."
Noah beckoned towards it.
"You can go ahead and attack."
WAA!
Immense pride and anger of the dragon race rose from the depths of the Silver Striped Imoogi's soul at such words as the hesitation and pressure it felt dissipated.

Its wings flared out as its chest expanded, a runic magic circle quickly becoming etched on its jaws as an instant later, condensed singularities filled with destructive waves of Dissolution and other concepts manifested in large numbers.
When near Scions felt the pressure emanating from these condensed singularities, their gazes became stern as they could sense the deadly potency within a single one.
A single one was equivalent to an attack that one of the more prominent Scions from the major Inheritances or Seven Clans could unleash!
Yet dozens of them formed as the angered and wounded pride of the Silver Striped Imoogi utilized more than 60% of its Aeonic Soul Values into this single move.
[Barrage of Extreme Sorrow!]
The will of the Silver Striped Imoogi blared out as at a rapid pace, the condensed singularities of Dissolution surged out towards the visage of Noah's Quintessential Emperor of Extremity!
At such a critical juncture, not a single move was made on his part.
He calmly watched the surging points of singularities that quickly arrived before his visage, each one being ten times larger than him as they all came from the colossal Silver Striped Imoogi!
Yet as the first one threatened to eclipse and erase him out of Existence...a fantastical scene that caused many beings to pause occurred.
BZZZT!

The buzzing singularity reached his body as he neither evaded nor made a move, not even lifting a finger as the moment it was about to reach him, a thin layer of light lit up that absolutely prevented anything from even landing on his skin.
An Innate Quintessential Hyperversal Barrier.

It caused the first cluster of essence that reached him to vibrate at a shocking rate as an instant later, the entire volatile mass of singularity broke down and turned into fine dust as if it was ground down to nothingness!
And for the dozen other singularities that followed...
PUFF! PUFF! PUFF!
At the moment of impact, each of them turned to dust as they couldn't even graze his stellar skin!
Such a scene alarmed many, but none more than the Silver Striped Imoogi as the roused anger and pride faded as it remembered the sense of oppression it felt before.
CRACK!
The runic magic circle before its jaws that was releasing the dense clusters of singularities actually broke and fizzled out at such a time as his ability actually failed to remain cast.
A deep ominous sensation descended as the Silver Striped Imoogi heard the voice of the dazzling existence it had targeted.
"A worthy effort..."
A worthy effort!
These three words caused the soul of the Silver Striped Imoogi to tremble as they seemed like the judgment of an executioner!
And it truly was a worthy effort, but Noah affirmed that his Barrier alone could block attacks equivalent to 3 Quintessential Hyperversal Defense Values!
This was because his Reified Source of Quintessence could display 9x the capabilities of his main body.
His one third Defense Value equivalent to an Apex Aeonic Damage Value became 3 for the Quintessential Emperor of Extremity, and his Damage Value of one tenth...
He wanted to see the magnificence of an attack that would nearly reach the might of an average newly transformed Apex Aeonic Lifeform.
And so with a tinge of sentimentality as he began on a new path with a wondrous set of Damage and Defense Values...he uttered out calmly as he tapped with his finger.
"Fireball."
Noah's Reified Source of Quintessence stood near the forefront of the Scions along with Erikson, Ayame, Atlas, Lodovico, and other notable Scions who faced their own deadly Leviathans of Dissolution.

Apart from the Silver Striped Imoogi eclipsing everything before him, there were other Leviathans behind this one as well as the interweaving branches of dissolution holding hundreds of Extremity Panaceas.
Yet the moment he uttered the word fireball...
The sight of the Imoogi who was hundreds of times larger than him changed.
Its sight became obscured by a fiery Crimson light!
But it wasn't alone.
The Leviathans of Dissolution behind it to its left and right.
The Leviathans in the distance floating near dense clusters of Extremity Panaceas.

Each one was akin to the size of a world compared to the average Scions here as at this moment, they found their sight bathed with a crimson light while their surrounding reality instantly turned blazing!
The Imoogi was the closest to Noah as it heard the word this being uttered out that cemented its judgment.
At the last moment, it wanted to say that this wasn't a ball of fire.
As its silver black scales melted along with the immolation of its Aspects of Existence, it had a single thought.
'This...is a Plane.'
BZZZT!

What appeared with Noah's simple tap was a enormous circular fiery Crimson singularity that covered the Silver Striped Imoogi within it along with 9 other massive Leviathans of Dissolution that were around or behind it!

And none of them had even a nanosecond more to exist as their Aspects of Existence were burnt to declare nothingness, .9 Quintessential Hyperversal Damage Values being unleashed until each of them as the Reified Source of Quintessence showed its grandeur!
And the so called fireball that caused nearby reality to melt and the Scions nearby to move away in shock...it remained floating and burning as it was akin to a unprecedented Plane of Flames!

chapters.title: Chapter 2463 Humiliation! II
paragraphs: 2463 Humiliation! II
CRACKLE!
Immense heat and scalding waves spread as the cast fireball that was akin to a Major Sun Plane of Existence remained burning even after the Leviathans within were burnt to nothingness.
This conflagration of flames that seemed like a burning Sun Plane remained and would stay for the future to come as this reality was utterly changed due to this single attack that took a mere tap.

The nearby reality turned hellish as magma-like stream of light formed on the surface of this Sun Plane, blazing winds and heat beginning to emanate out in the distance as any nearby Scions behind instinctively moved back!
Their scalps tingled as they watched.
Such a level of damage caused them to turn entirely somber as it was far above what any Dynamis of Extremity should do in the hands of an existence that hadn't undergone Apexification!
Far in the back, near the entry of the fissure leading into the Extremity Vein of Dissolution.
Figures hidden in a unique veil appeared silently as they also gazed towards this shocking phenomenon.
Among them, a humanoid Existence with a single central eye blinked with scrutiny as he spoke out.

"This actually seems to be a tough one physically and with the output of his power- whether it's momentary or not. We also haven't collected enough information on his Absolute Dynamis of Extremity so a direct confrontation would not be ideal. Skylar...this may be a better match for you."
As he spoke, he gazed towards a green haired woman whose verdant hair didn't emanate life, but instead seemed extremely vile and poisonous!

Her eyes shone with a beautiful verdant luster as her face carried itself with a deadly beauty, a black robe covering her curvy figure as she smiled kindly towards the words of the One-Eyes Existence.
"Naturally. Though once I make a move..."

"We will all also move to the other targets. Divide and Conquer amidst the chaos, take them away from any possible sources of support or reinforcement. Then...we shall all gather back here with even greater glory."
Another voice emanated out as this time, it was from a dark skinned man with a shining bald head adorned in a priest's robe, a large prayer bead in his hands as his eyes burned with righteousness!
BZZT!
The potent power of these beings buzzed as the verdant haired woman named Skylar was the first to make a move.
She was most ideal for beings who were excessively strong physically or held powerful concepts of Extremity that weren't fully understood.

This was because she held a Mutated Soul that granted her a reality altering ability known as Aeonic Soul Consecration Domain that allowed her to stake her soul and the Soul of her target in a sacred soul battlefield outside of time where they would vie for supremacy!
The one with the strongest soul would come out on top as they would attain the memories, talent, soul strength, and concepts of the defeated.

Her ability was already deadly enough, but three hundred years ago, she was able to defeat another Mutated Entity and devour Aspects of their reality altering ability, her Aeonic Soul Consecration being transformed as now, it could isolate the souls within the sacred soul battlefield from their Concepts of Extremity while affording her ten times her normal Soul Value while battling with Aeonic Soul Consecration.

Her soul was already abundant enough after she devoured the strength and concepts of many beings, but she was given wings to expand even further with such a transformation as he terrifying would it be for one to be separated from their concepts entirely as they only had to rely on the nature and strength of their soul?!

A smile curved across her lips as her body shifted across space, her target set as she moved towards the direction of the Quintessential Emperor of Extremity while activating Aeonic Soul Consecration.
She never had to use more than 50% of her Aeonic Soul Values before to pull an enemy in, and she didn't expect this time to be any different!
Noah's mind was akin to a Convergence of millions of thoughts as countless possibilities flitted across it every second.
And seconds back, he felt Providence shining as he actually gained the knowledge that he would be targeted, with there being boundless possibilities if he played things out properly!
'Not just from the Leviathans of Dissolution...other Scions?'
He felt like he had eyes in the back of his head as he smiled.
He stopped expressing the effects of Hyperversal Dignity.
He wanted to let whatever enemies there were to attack him as thereafter, they would be turned into Loot!
And he didn't have to wait long before he felt a piercing soul power try to connect to his soul right after the defeat of the Silver Striped Imoogi and multiple other Leviathans.
'Oh?'
It felt ticklish as it couldn't even bypass his Innate Quintessential Hyperversal Barrier, but it held a trace of uniqueness that tried to burrow in while ignoring set up defenses!
'Interesting...'
Noah's blinding eyes released an ever brighter luster as he opened up his Barrier and allowed this soul light in.
SHIING!
It managed to touch his pristine soul as he found a part of himself pulled towards a space where uniquely, time felt distorted!
His interest was piqued as he followed the lull of the soul trying to pull him somewhere, coming to arrive at the set location even before this Soul as he gazed around it.

It was a small circular domain that at this moment was trembling, Noah's portion of soul contained within being so massive that the domain seemed like a stretched out bubble with Noah's figure being massive and towering past its boundaries as it nearly burst!

He controlled his soul as his figure reduced, his power entirely contained within as he shrank until he became 2 meters in this circular domain that seemed like a small world with roiling green clouds beneath his feet.

The being that had pulled him in here had yet to arrive herself, Noah sensing the changes around him as the authority of this region actually made it so that his connection to his authorities and concepts was very thin!

He found this interesting as he waved his hands and pulled the soul of the being that had initiated this ability closer, allowing her soul to descend at a faster pace as a bright light bloomed not too far from him!

She never had to use more than 50% of her Aeonic Soul Values before to pull an enemy in, and she didn't expect this time to be any different!
Noah's mind was akin to a Convergence of millions of thoughts as countless possibilities flitted across it every second.
And seconds back, he felt Providence shining as he actually gained the knowledge that he would be targeted, with there being boundless possibilities if he played things out properly!
'Not just from the Leviathans of Dissolution...other Scions?'
He felt like he had eyes in the back of his head as he smiled.
He stopped expressing the effects of Hyperversal Dignity.
He wanted to let whatever enemies there were to attack him as thereafter, they would be turned into Loot!
And he didn't have to wait long before he felt a piercing soul power try to connect to his soul right after the defeat of the Silver Striped Imoogi and multiple other Leviathans.
'Oh?'
It felt ticklish as it couldn't even bypass his Innate Quintessential Hyperversal Barrier, but it held a trace of uniqueness that tried to burrow in while ignoring set up defenses!
'Interesting...'
Noah's blinding eyes released an ever brighter luster as he opened up his Barrier and allowed this soul light in.
SHIING!
It managed to touch his pristine soul as he found a part of himself pulled towards a space where uniquely, time felt distorted!
His interest was piqued as he followed the lull of the soul trying to pull him somewhere, coming to arrive at the set location even before this Soul as he gazed around it.

It was a small circular domain that at this moment was trembling, Noah's portion of soul contained within being so massive that the domain seemed like a stretched out bubble with Noah's figure being massive and towering past its boundaries as it nearly burst!

He controlled his soul as his figure reduced, his power entirely contained within as he shrank until he became 2 meters in this circular domain that seemed like a small world with roiling green clouds beneath his feet.

The being that had pulled him in here had yet to arrive herself, Noah sensing the changes around him as the authority of this region actually made it so that his connection to his authorities and concepts was very thin!

He found this interesting as he waved his hands and pulled the soul of the being that had initiated this ability closer, allowing her soul to descend at a faster pace as a bright light bloomed not too far from him!

chapters.title: Chapter 2464 Humiliation! III
paragraphs: 2464 Humiliation! III

The light revealed the image of a venomous beautiful woman who whistled as soon as she arrived, a misconception forming in her mind as she gazed towards Noah and believed the two of them had arrived here at the same time.
"Sheesh, you're the first one to make me use up this much soul power just to bring you in. Did your Absolute Seed of Extremity boost you this much?"
As she spoke, she took calm steps towards Noah as she seemed unhurried and without any fear!
She even held great expectations as she laughed while continuing to speak, her eyes observing Noah who was displayed in his human form along with his devilish looks.
"You must be feeling confused right now. Can't sense any of your Boundaries or your budding Dynamis of Extremity? Can't even sense your body outside of here?"

"No need to worry. I welcome you to my Aeonic Soul Consecration Domain. In here, we can spend days while barely a nanosecond passes outside. And I...can take all the time I need to grind down your soul and obtain whatever mutation makes you unique!"
Noah's eyes squinted devilishly as he couldn't help but form a smile while he looked at this being who truly had no idea just who she had targeted.
She saw his smile as she shook her head with a powerful light.

"Ah yes, the smile of confidence that I've seen on so many others before. You don't know the terror of my Aeonic Soul Consecration Domain until I've shown you a few times just how naked you are without your Concepts of Extremity. You see, in here, the only crucial thing is the nature of your soul. And in this space...the nature of my soul is the strongest!"
BOOM!

Wild waves of power erupted out with her words as the domain they were in trembled! Her hands rose as a verdant blade coalesced in her hands, her eyes cold as it struck down towards Noah's visage with a deadly killing intent.
Yet before it could even near...
SHAA!
Noah waved his hand simply as the conjured verdant blade disappeared
Skylar blinked a few times as Noah's smile only became more devilish.

"You don't seem to understand just who you have brought into a critical piece of your soul." Noah's voice boomed out in all directions as the circular domain they were in trembled from its sheer might.
The roiling green clouds seethed with terror at the mere strength of his words as the gaze of Skylar's soul changed!
Her hands moved commandingly once more as she tried to use her control in the Aeonic Soul Consecration Domain, and yet it seemed none of the essence and authority in here was listening to her.
Her ability.
Her wonder!
She actually couldn't control it as it could only mean...the other soul in this space was so much greater that it was influencing everything here under its will!
Her pupils trembled as in the next second, the small figure of the man who should have been contained in this domain began to enlarge.

His size came to far surpass her small figure as he expanded into a titanic stature that felt like it couldn't be contained in this small domain, coming to even reach the edges of its boundary as his gaze then bore down towards her with utmost glory!
Skylar felt a perilous sense of danger at such a phenomenon as immense fear rose up, realizing the nature of the soul of this being was far, far greater than any of them had imagined!
So she instantly activated her safeguard that she had never before utilized.
At the heavy cost of wounding her soul, she could cancel her Aeonic Soul Consecration Domain and separate herself from the target she was connected to!
Yet the moment she tried this...
Nothing occurred.
THUMP!
She was in her soul form, and yet she felt the illusory sensation of her heart beating fearfully.
She stared at the massive visage of the being towering over her Aeonic Soul Consecration Domain as he gazed down towards her coldly, as if she was a mere rat or insect trapped in his grand design!
"Name."
BZZT!
A single word.
Yet Skylar's soul faced tumultuous waves of oppression as she forgot everything about her pride and magnificence as she stammered out her words.
"Skylar. Skylar Blackvine."
Her soul trembled as she felt as if she was speaking in front of the revered Apex Aeonic Lifeforms of her Clan!
His exceedingly cold eyes flashed as he spoke again.
"Affiliation."
"Part of the hidden Scions of the Avernus Clan." Skylar spoke out hurriedly as her soul was thoroughly grasped by fear!
"And the crux of this domain?"
Like a billowing ancient giant, he inquired authoritatively as Skylar replied while her verdant pupils trembled!
"A domain where the winning soul...devours everything about the other person."
As she said these words, she trembled.
This was because in the next moment...
"Oh."
A single word was uttered.
Then Noah's massive visage brought its hand down, the weight of the whole world crashing down towards Skylar!
A domain where the nature of one's Soul was the most important as they were cut off from their Boundaries and Dynamis.
With his Quintessential Hyperversal Soul, the enemy was only throwing themselves into oblivion by targeting him!
"Wait...!"
A pleading cry was the only thing to come out, and it was thoroughly ignored as the visage of a massive hand smashed down.
Why Skylar had released her attack, the other Mutated Entities targeting the prominent Scions also moved!

Each one held their own unique might as they thundered down not just to clash with their chosen targets- but also erupting to cause utmost chaos as they had the goal of isolating, dividing, and conquering.

The One-Eyed Existence targeted the robed Atlas who was surrounded by plum petals, his figure blaring like a black pillar of light that Atlas instinctively felt it and turned around to clash with- their forms shooting out towards the vines filled with Extremity Panaceas in the far distance!

A similar scene occurred for most prominent Scions as a violet beam of light crashed into Erikson, a transparent barrier radiant around him as his eyes rose up authoritatively while his dark hands waved down with dominance!

chapters.title: Chapter 2465 Humiliation! IV
paragraphs: 2465 Humiliation! IV
Chaos bloomed across this region as Ayame, Lodovico, and many others were targeted by unknown combatants.

The Leviathans of Dissolution that were still recovering from the shock of the massive blaring Sun Plane still burning before a certain someone also recovered as they used this chaos to fight back and flip this area utterly wild.
Barely a nanosecond had passed since everything began, with Noah's figure only stopped lightly as not too long later, his eyes regained their full faculties as he gazed at the prompts before him.
[You have come out as the victor from the Aeonic Soul Consecration Domain!]
[Everything of the defeated party is claimed by you.]
[A type of Golden Soul Mutationem Embryo has been obtained!]
His eyes opened sharply.
In his soul, a dazzling jewel-like singularity bloomed as it released pristine waves of authority that emanated change and transformation!
His will focused on it as wondrous details bloomed soon after.

[Golden Soul Mutationem Embryo]:: An Embryo holding the reality altering trait of Aeonic Soul Consecration Domain. One can choose to devour it as depending on the strength of their Soul, they may either obtain all of the Trait or only parts of it. The Mutationem Embryo can also be utilized as fuel to empower already existing traits to express even greater reality altering capabilities. Existing traits or reality altering features linked to your soul that are capable of advancement: Infinite Mana, Unrecorded Aeonic Quintessential Hyperversal Extremity Foundation, Infinite System...
WAA!
A short and simple description of utmost glory.
A Soul Mutationem Embryo that could be utilized in different ways- to the extent that it could have been applied to a variety of Reality Altering features or abilities under Noah!
It wasn't just limited to Traits as Noah could use it as fuel for even something as wondrous as the Unrecorded Aeonic Quintessential Hyperversal Extremity Foundation.
After Noah read its details, he couldn't help but smile brilliantly as the memories from Skylar swirled across his mind.

She was a hidden Scion of the Avernus Clan as it seemed among the Inheritances at the very peak of power in the Aeonic Havens of Extremity, there were of course those standing against others whether in the open or in the dark!
And she was not alone as Noah's eyes perused the memories of all the beings she came with.
Each of them with their own unique identity as they were Mutated Entities or normal Scions who had absorbed traces of a Mutationem Embryo!

What was even more astounding was the path they took to get here as this was a cluster of beings which branched off from Elder Scions holding might at the Apex Aeonic Lifeform level, such beings currently spread out across the Haven of Dissolution as above all of them and working in tandem with this group currently...
Was none other than an existence that had achieved Hyperversal Extremity Authority.
And not just that, but they also held Vacuous Hyperversal Authority as well!
Noah couldn't help but lick his lips at such a vast cluster of possible Loot.
His eyes shone with a devilish glint as even when faced with the possibility of an intervention of a Hyperversal Extremity Existence, he was unfettered and didn't even think of stepping back!
His memories from Skylar were broken down as the profiles of multiple of her comrades appeared, his body flashing with indomitable might as he moved towards a certain direction soon after!
"Haha, the famous Son of Haven, Atlas! To think you would form a Dynamis of Extremity without even the interference of treasures...what exactly are you hiding in your soul?!"

A booming voice followed by bookings pillars of black light smashed down as stellar black, gold, and white vines were ripped out, scintillating Golden Extremity Panaceas thrown about and floating in space wondrously.
Atlas' robe was drenched in a deeply pink light as he held his white sword in front of him, his eyes sharp as he stared at the One-Eyed Existence before him!
He was actually someone that Atlas had heard of before- from the reclusive and hidden giant known as the Avernus Clan!
"The One-Eyed Hunter Azazel...what bolstered you to have crawled out of the hole in the depths of hell you normally hide in?"

Atlas' eyes were sharp as 150 years ago, stories had spread about how Scions from the Avernus Clan and the Barbarians of Extremity had come to a conflict, and there was outrage at the atrocities where Azazel wiped out entire squadrons of Scions until Apex Aeonic Lifeforms had to intervene- a small war breaking out between the two sides!
He had moved in the shadows thereafter as not much was heard about him, but for him to appear here...
Atlas had a calm expression as he pulled his sword close.
His memories as a Regressor didn't show much about this being as he had only seen a few of the possibilities.
He gazed towards the far away blinding Sun Plane that a unique existence had cast and their current position as he voiced out while hundreds of Plum petals unfurled around him.
"I've heard that you are a Mutated Entity with something called..."
"Absolute Defense Penetration." Azazel's voice rang out domineeringly as his hands conjured dozens of black pillars of light.

His single eye squinted with bloodlust as he was a being who could ignore the authorities of other beings' boundaries and to an extent even Dynamis of Extremity to entirely bypass their defenses and directly wound their souls!
He was a straightforward and deadly combatant whose attacks had caught many off guard with their deaths being cemented.
His body bellowed with pillars of black light as he bellowed out!

"I come today with the glorious purpose of claiming nothing else other than your soul. Thereafter...I shall establish my Foundation before participating in the Culmination Step of the Extremity Vein of Dissolution where even your Elders of the Plum Sword of Extremity...they shall all be falling under my ar-"
BZZZT!

Before Azazel could finish his hand monologue, space warped as the appearance of the Quintessential Emperor of Extremity appeared behind him- the arms of this pristine Existence coming from both left and right as two radiant cherry-colored Infinity symbols rotated and smashed towards each other with Azazel at the center!

His head was barely able to turn as his eyes showed unbelievable shock and a rising sense of dread, but the two hands with rotating Infinity symbols came together without any interference as akin to a pancake...the entire body of Azazel was flattened!
Torrential waves of an Absolute Dynamis of Extremity vibrated as an instant later, the flattened being buzzed as everything about him was ground to dust.
Atlas was silent as he contained his shock, because what had just happened wasn't even a fight.
It was utter humiliation!
And the being responsible seemed unfettered as his voice emanated out.
"Another one down."
The appearance of the Reified Source of Quintessence uttered out with a devilish glint in its eyes as a message rose.
[A type of Golden Body Mutationem Embryo has been obtained!]
A dazzling message that only caused his eyes to shine with a greedy light of greed as without even gazing at Atlas, he turned towards another direction where the next Mutated Entity lay!

chapters.title: Chapter 2466 No Mercy! I
paragraphs: 2466 No Mercy! I
Henry gazed at the fantastical scene of the expansion of utterly massive Aletheian Hyperversal Planes that used to be small Dimensions not too long ago.

His sight focused on the lowest layer which was the past Dream Dimension as he saw rapidly proliferating sandy gold mountains that were as massive as cosmos, with some snaking across the land to be as stupendous ancient holy lands!
They seemed like a mere glimpse of the titanic Reality Passages he at times saw in his father's Origin along with the unbreakable pillars of stanchions of glorious light.
A sense of profundity was contained within as he watched this process, with his thoughts disorganized as he pondered about what to do for his own Origin.
There were a great deal of opportunities from his father, and if he grasped this one to forge something utterly unimaginable...
HOONG!
While in his thoughts, he felt the booming aura of an Apex Aeonic Lifeform behind him as the visage of Orion came to a stop a few meters from him.
His own gaze was a mix of emotions as this was an Ancestor of the Lernaean Lineage who was the very first True Emperor of the past Barren Lands!
Henry knew why he was here as he spoke calmly towards this being even though he should have been someone of much higher status than him!
"Have you come to take back your eyes?"
He had lived for a truly short period of time.
And yet he spoke to a being that had lived for billions of years freely- the tyranny of the Quintessential Hyperversal Emperor Lineage burning brightly inside him!
Orion looked at this while shaking his head with a smile.

"You are not far from your father at all. No, I am not here to take back those eyes. After I lost my connection to them, I never tried to regain it as without them, my vision only continued to expand. But...they are still part of me. I wish to know how they have been used. I wish to know how they ended up in your hands."
His voice was akin to that of an old man wishing to ease his heart as Henry turned towards him briefly before turning his gaze back to the expanding Haven before him.
His voice was light as he began slowly.
"The last person to have them, however briefly it was, was a child known as Oppenheimer..."
A story began between an existence with an utterly young soul and one who had experienced too much age and time!
BOOM!
A shocking battle!
Erikson's figure was indomitable as the probability of piercing through the barrier around him was still at 0, yet the force his enemy released was still enough to push his body back.

With no injuries, his dominating visage ripped apart the black gold branching Vein he had smashed into, his hand motioning towards the two Golden Extremity Panaceas blooming from its stalk as they were propelled towards him- disappearing into his unique storage as soon as they neared him!
He then licked his lips as he remained carefree, bending down to pull one of his beach slippers off of his right foot and grasping it in his hands.
"Now you've gone and made me draw my weapon. Are you ready for what is to come?"
He grasped the slipper in his hands with shocking dominance as his enemy was a tall humanoid whose entire body was made of pulsing neon lights.

She felt the rising pressure in the surroundings as she scoffed, the robe she wore coming off as one could see a glistening automaton skin layered with dense neon lights, her hands forming into pulsing cannon like weapons as her plump breasts were circular metal blessing that released a gleaming mechanical light!

As she glared at Erikson holding the slipper in his hands, anger rose in her heart as behind her back, the sound of an engine humming began to resound as hundreds of illusory drones appeared behind her.
"I hate fools like you the most. Fools that have lived a life so good that they take nothing seriously."
WAA!
Each of the Hundreds of drones in the skies gradually became real as they shone with a dangerous glint- the power they released matching an Unequaled Reverend Emperor for every single one!
It was like facing a few hundred Unequaled Reverend Emperors in the form of neon death drones, yet Erikson seemed unfettered.

"Remember my name as you perish. I am the disciple of the great Hyperversal Extremity Mechanica. I fused my wounded soul with countless automatons until I gained a alteration capable of turning the bodies of my enemies into an army of automatons that are impervious to Boundary Essences!"
The fluorescent lights around her blared gorgeously as the hundreds of drones behind her pulsed while releasing pulsing missiles from their lower compartments- ready to bombard everything here!
Gazing at this scene, Erikson scoffed as he raised the slipper in his hand- this simple object expanding and becoming enormous above him as a fantastical distorted probability was attached to it.
Yet the enemy before him continued.

"I am the ruler of the Innumerable Drones of Destruction. And I will have my retaliation against the Clans that wiped out my whole Inheritance because of their greed for our technology. You will just be the first. This, I swear in my name. For I am Sal-...!?"
BOOOM!
Her words first get to finish.

From above, the splendid figure of the Quintessential Emperor of Extremity had appeared as his hands held a sparkling cherry colored spear of light- this spear smashing down from above as it pierced the head of the mechanical existence before Erikson, facing no obstruction as the Spear continued further down and separated the chest, waist, and eventually the entire body was split in two from top to bottom!
Thereafter...
BZZT!

The essence of the Indefatigable Dynamis of Extremity buzzed as the two halves of the body and every trace of Aspects of Existence they held became wrapped in a light of destruction as they turned into dust!

A sense of profundity was contained within as he watched this process, with his thoughts disorganized as he pondered about what to do for his own Origin.
There were a great deal of opportunities from his father, and if he grasped this one to forge something utterly unimaginable...
HOONG!

Henry knew why he was here as he spoke calmly towards this being even though he should have been someone of much higher status than him!
"Have you come to take back your eyes?"

chapters.title: Chapter 2467 No Mercy! II
paragraphs: 2467 No Mercy! II
A cherry colored spear descended from nowhere and turned its target to dust soon after, a prompt rising before Noah's eyes soon after as the illusory drones in the surroundings faded.
{A type of Golden Origin Mutationem Embryo has been obtained!}
A welcomed prompt that came at the same time as Erikson's voice echoed out in the distance.
"You didn't have to kill steal a creature like that...I was curious about her mutation too!"
The slipper in his hands reduced in size as Noah's visage gazed towards him calmly while replying.
"You all take too long and give them time to begin telling their histories and motivations."
"The motivations of these foes do not matter. Lesser side characters like them should only have a line or two before they perish."
WAA!
Noah's voice was resonant as he had already heard the brief histories of two of these Mutated Entities before they died.
Even though they had been killed seconds in between, Noah still felt like it was taking too long as before any major changes occurred, he wanted to sweep all of them away and make them his Loot!
To accomplish such a thing quickly, his eyes shone as an ability that would aid him in doing just that was available.
And it was one that he wanted to test out as well.
It was String Theory Manifestation!

{String Theory Manifestation}:: The nature of reality has been a conundrum that many have tried to solve. This ability allows you to discern reality and its makeup through the lens of an infinite number of Aletheian strings moving in harmony to form the very fabric of reality, waves of vibrations being released that usher forth the movements of the very atoms and forces that make up nature in different dimensions. It is but a theory, but a manifestation of it makes it closer towards truth than a theory. Activating it will passively deplete your soul values as you enter a state where you can manipulate nature smoothly through the vibrations of strings and how they alter the different dimensions of reality. Greater understanding of this will increase the rate of Convergence of the Aletheian Dynamis of Extremity and even the formation of your Aletheian Havens of Extremity...
A feature that took the 9th Boundary Layer of Dimensions and put it on steroids!

The 9th Boundary Layer of Dimensions gave Noah a peek at utilizing the string like vibrations of nature and how different Dimensions of reality came to be because of it, but the control gained from String Theory Manifestation was unimaginably greater.
And now, he wanted to see just to what extent the different dimensions of reality could be manipulated with it!
"String Theory Manifestation."
HUUM!
Time seemed to slow down Infinitely to the point that it came to a halt.
With his Quintessential Emperor of Extremity at the very center, a black gold light of utmost regality flourished around Noah and spread out.
His eyes of singularities were closed as with his body at the center, he felt countless string like vibrations emanating outwards and continuing to propagate towards the nearby reality!
They spread far and wide as they came to cover Erikson.
Noah's soul felt like it was interconnected to the countless vibrations of the Aletheian Strings as he was everywhere they passed.

The vibrations passed through Erikson as Noah felt the transparent Boundary around this being that held a staunch and unbreakable dominance of reality. Yet he knew that in this state, he could manipulate the string like vibrations to break down this Authority and reach the Aspects of Existence of this being!
But this wasn't the current enemy.
The Aletheian Strings continued to spread outwards as very quickly, they covered vast distances as Ayame's figure and the one attacking her could be seen.
Lodovico's visage and his attacker could be seen!
Bharatam of the Prometheus Clan and his attacker could be felt as the countless strings like vibrations reached them!

Antoinette of the Scholars of Extremity with her wand thrust out and blaring with singularities could be seen as her attacker was a massive existence that had transformed into a Reality Devouring Gold Ant.
Noah felt all of this as with the countless string like vibrations he felt, it was as if his will had reached all of these places!

The makeup of reality was that of these strings and the vibrations they released. So if he used the dominance of the Aletheian Dynamis of Extremity to simply impose his will through these materialized strings...
THUMP!
He felt the beat of his heart as with his eyes closed, he grasped the Spear filled with the essence of the Indefatigable Dynamis of Extremity...and threw it in front of him.

The Spear was wrapped in the countless string like vibrations as an instant later, it disappeared as if it melded and traversed through them, crossing vast distances like nothing as it warped across space to manifest once more from the strings right before the enemy that Ayame faced!

At this same time, Noah's right hand that had just released the Spear thrust out with a fist- a massive black gold stellar illusory fist materializing and shooting out as it also melded in the string like vibrations and instantly came to appear behind the enemy in front of Antoinette!
Noah's left hand then tapped as a ray of severing light formed and shot out, carried by the string like vibrations to instantly appear above the Mutated Entity that Lodovico faced.

Thereafter, a sea of blue flames bloomed before him as they also spread out in different directions, being carried by the countless strings he could feel as they instantly appeared next to their targets!
And in the nanosecond that followed...reality resumed as normal.
Yet before multiple Mutated Entities, horrific attacks arrived at the same time as a burning cherry colored spear annihilated reality around one entity.
A massive black gold fist arrived to flatten another Mutated Entity!
A severing ray of light pierced the head of another Mutated Entity who was just about to begin a speech.
And then...massive cerulean seas of flames descended from nowhere as their targets were immolated into nothingness a nanosecond after they were covered!
THUMP!
Noah felt all this as before his luminous eyes...
{A type of Golden Soul Mutationem Embryo has been obtained!}
{A type of Golden Soul Mutationem Embryo has...}
{A type of Golden Body Mutationem Embryo...}
Radiant prompts rained down as the True Emperor of Quintessence eliminated all his foes at once- without even an ounce of mercy!
Tomorrow's working chapter titles: No Mercy! III, Xiaomi I
Adui

chapters.title: Chapter 2468 Xiaomi! I
paragraphs: 2468 Xiaomi! I
Within the Aeonic Haven of Dissolution.

Closer towards the Quasarian Lands where one of Noah's clones was making their way, the skies and the earth were inverted and twisted as broken landmass floated on top while a sky pulsing with tendrils of Ruin and Nullity vibrantly boomed in the bottom.

Past such a region, dense clusters of Planes of Existence shining with obsidian light and pulsing with exaggerated grandeur of a hint of quasars could be seen- a great deal of modifications made on these planes to make them appear like so.
Within the center of one of the more massive planes, towards the deepest reaches of the Sacred Quasarian Lands.
The auras of power contained in this region were much denser than normal as there were nearly three times as many Apex Aeonic Lifeforms as there were before!
The reason for this was none other than the fact that the Aeonic Inheritance of Extremity known as Singularity Overseers had integrated themselves into the Quasarian Lineage!
The Light of the Seven was linked to the Planeswalkers and the Genesis Institute of Extremity was connected to the Noblesse, with the Cult of Endless Shadows sharing an alliance with the Lernaeans.

Many things were done for the start of a smooth relationship between the joining forces as at this moment, two Apex Aeonic Lifeforms were moving across the central Sacred Quasarian Plane while one talked.

"This is the center of our power as this Plane holds a region of Aeonic Quasar Stalagmites- treasures very conducive to our power as we mine a million units every month, and they still continue to propagate."

An Apex Aeonic Quasarian was speaking while adorned in a stellar obsidian robe, his dazzling obsidian skin made up of countless quasars shining with a powerful light as he introduced the structure of the Quasarian Lineage towards the leading Elder of the Singularity Overseers.

The being beside him adorned a vibrant purple robe on his fair body, dark hair just reaching his shoulders as his visage showed boundless grace and beauty. He nodded lightly while they continued to tour around the Quasarian Domains.
Eventually, they crossed a region where the Apex Aeonic Lifeform from the Singularity Overseers raised his brows while pointing towards a certain area.
"Elder Booma, that...veiled domain over there. You haven't said anything about it, yet it seems to hold an air of treasures exceeding any other locations we've been in."
His gaze pierced across the many veils as he saw a hidden Plane of Existence!

"Ah, Grand Singularity Elder Zeitgeist, that's a sore point for our Lineage." Elder Booma of the Quasarian Lineage began slowly with a difficult look, showing slight hesitation as he continued soon after.

"The veiled plane is filled with countless treasures promoting life force and Vitality because within it, one of our most prized young Scions lies. She was the brightest Quasar to have been born in our whole Lineage, with her aptitude in the Boundary Expansion Realm being so terrifying that she was reaching 9th Boundary Layers in all the concepts she was curious about within decades. Yet, calamity stuck as an unexplainable phenomenon occurred the first day she ventured out. She passed over a region filled with Voidness and Ruin as an instant later, the whole dreadful sea of Ruin in that region surged and poured into her endlessly!"
WAA!

"Tendrils and tendrils of Ruin that could fill up tens of Planes of Existence surged into her and filled up every part of her soul, this source of chaos not letting up and continuing to surge into her as we had to forcefully move her body away and stop it from coming near here, with everything coming to a stop thereafter. After bringing her back into our lands though, we found dense Devastation coursing through her soul and vessels as it poisonously began to eat away at everything, her power and grandeur slowly fading to the point that it seemed all other concepts she had were eaten away as the only thing to remain in her Aspects of Existence was Ruin. Ruin that just continued to kill her day by day as at this point, we don't think she has more than a hundred years left. We've tried all avenues to cure her, but alas..."
His expression was one of pity as he shook his head at what could have been!
Grand Singularity Elder Zeitgeist's brows rose with interest at such a story as he spoke cooly.
"Let's go see. I may be able to be of help."
A request that caused Senior Booma of the Quasarian Family to hesitate.
He thought of the father of the dying girl in this veiled domain who didn't let anyone near this plane apart from him as to allow an outsider...

"Surely, Elder Booma won't deny help for something like this as our forces are integrated to become one?" Zeitgeist spoke with a sense of pressure as soon after, Booma nodded as he slowly flew towards the veiled plane- waving his hands to remove the restrictions that only he and the Mad Reverend Emperor Caesar knew of!
And soon after, they entered the veiled plane.
Within it, dense waves of lifeforce emanated out of a cosmic sea of treasures swayed gorgeously with multiple colors of light.
In such a sea, the figures of Senior Booma and Zeitgeist very quickly locked onto the only Existence here.
Her life force was pulsing weakly as she swam in the cosmic sea of treasures, her gaze filled with countless thoughts as her body was radiant with an black light of Trillions of Quasars!

Yet on her body, one could see a sense of transparency as a dense network of vessels were seen- with thick tendrils of Ruin churning across these vessels constantly as they seemed heavily interconnected with her soul.
Booma sighed when he saw this.
Yet Grand Singularity Senior Zeitgeist...his eyes opened in shock as an instant later, this shock turned into joy and excitement that he quickly repressed!
His eyes flashed with a brilliant light as he smiled and spoke out in a voice that Senior Booma and the woman in the distance could hear.
"I can cure her."

chapters.title: Chapter 2469 Xiaomi! II
paragraphs: 2469 Xiaomi! II
"I can cure her."
BOOOM!
Explosive words rang out as in the distance, the figure of Xiaomi turned and gazed towards them calmly.
Booma became shocked as he voiced out hurriedly.
"Truly? How can you say that with such confidence? The only avenue we saw was to maybe have an Esteemed Extremity that had achieved Extremity in Ruin or something similar. Is that..."
"Haha, something like that. But I recognize her condition." Zeitgeist spoke freely as he floated closer towards Xiaomi.
"Her condition is a blessing in disguise of a calamity, and my Master...he will be able to entirely cure her. Young Quasarian...do you want to be rid of this ailment?"
His body emanated grand authority as a purple glint shone in his eyes, affirming his thoughts when he arrived ever closer to this being before him.
The transparent look of her body as it looked crystalline and glass-like while all her veins, arteries, capillaries, and every single vessel could be seen with glass-like clarity!
He had seen this before within one of the most prized Extremity Cultivation Furnaces that his master used!
Others may not be able to put things together, but Zeitgeist knew that what this being held was one of the extremely rare Innate Extremity Foundations- the Pellucid Hyperversal Foundation!
Glass like vessels and a unique disposition!

It held [Hyperversal] in its name as it was a shocking Foundation that took a specific essence it was innately attracted to towards Extremity at a very rapid pace, but it held a deadly drawback as if one didn't contain it when they were exposed to the Innate selected essence, they would perish before they even knew what they held.
This was the case with the being before him as Ruin had interlinked itself with all of her Aspects of Existence.
And of course it would do so when it was attracted to the Pellucid Hyperversal Foundation!

This girl knew nothing about it even with her genius as she wasn't able to properly take reigns, her blessing becoming a misfortune as now, she was dying from the very Source that would take her to Extremity in a short period of time.
'Haha...'

Zeitgeist contained his excitement as when it came to such beings, his Master collected those similar to them as in the past billions of years, he had only obtained a single being with Pellucid Hyperversal Foundation from one of his other Disciples.
And that being was now an Elder Brother of Zeitgeist who had already attained Extremity and sat himself close to their Master!

His Master collected unique beings like this for no other purpose than to use them as Extremity Cultivation Furnaces- with the only Pellucid Hyperversal Foundation Existence he had obtained having a link to Nullity as his master had utilized her until he achieved Extremity in Nullity, adding this as another concept he attained Hyperversal Extremity Authority in!

The Pellucid Hyperversal Foundation of that existence was pretty much used up after that, but she lived as there were still opportunities for her to reach Extremity through normal means like all others after she lost her Pellucid Hyperversal Foundation.
And if he presented another being with a Pellucid Hyperversal Foundation for his Master to attain Extremity in another field...
'Mmm, I will join Elder Brother Kabul in also being granted Extremity by Master...good!'
His thoughts were hidden as he stared at the visage of the young woman who didn't even know what she had.
Seeing her beauty that even matched women who had undergone Apexification...
'Yeah, Master would truly enjoy this gift!'
His ecstasy only rose as he spoke again, since this holder of the Pellucid Hyperversal Foundation seemed shocked and unable to answer after his grand words of being able to cure her!
"Well? The ailment that has been plaguing you all these years will be cured. We just have to make a trip to the Haven of Helios."
He put on his most benevolent smile as the young woman before him gazed up.
And in the next moment...
"No thanks."
WAA!
Shocking words that even caused Elder Booma beside them to blink in shock resounded out!
Booma was taken aback as he came closer to Xiaomi while speaking out.
"Little Xiaomi, this is what your father and the whole Quasarian Lineage has been looking for all this time, if there is a cure..."
The gaze of Zeitgeist didn't show a change of emotions at Xiaomi's words as his eyes only flashed sharply.
Xiaomi seemed to have a gentle nature as she turned her eyes that shone like weak singularities towards Elder Booma.
"Elder, my father had explicit rules that nobody other than you can enter into this domain. Why did you bring an outsider who wishes to usher me harm here?"
BOOM!
Shocking words emanated from her as Elder Booma blinked in a stupor.
Grand Singularity Elder Zeitgeist's eyes released beams of terrific light.
"Harm you? Such a thing...Little Xiaomi, this is an elder of the Aeonic Inheritance of Singularity Overseers. We are joining ourselves to them as Extremity Sanctification unfolds in our Haven."
Booma spoke slowly as he tried to salvage this unfolding situation.
Yet Xiaomi weakly rose from her current position as she gazed at the powerful existences before her calmly, her eyes locking onto the figure of Zeitgeist as she replied while shaking her head.
"As much as he hides it, the light of greed and malice is too strong in his eyes. He is not offering me any salvation, he instead wants to take whatever I have left."
One shocking word after another came out as Xiaomi spoke without fear while facing two Apex Aeonic Lifeforms!
"Haha!" Zeitgeist's laugh rang out as he shook his head with a smile.

"How could I have any intentions to hurt a youngster of a soon to be branch of Singularity Overseers? I will just take you to be cured in the Aeonic Haven of Helios as you will realize my intentions then."
He was smiling.
Yet his words now contained a sense of coercion as they seemed like they had to be followed!
At such a juncture...
"I would like to see just who dares to take my daughter away without my permission!"
BOOM!
A prevailing voice reverberated out as an astounding aura came in.
Radiant stellar black gold light covered the edges of the trillions of quasars that made him.
In his hands, an glorious Golden Haven Albatross could be seen as his eyes held a sense of ferocity and power.
It was none other than the Mad Apex Emperor Caesar!

chapters.title: Chapter 2470 Xiaomi! III
paragraphs: 2470 Xiaomi! III
The Mad Apex Emperor Caesar arrived in the veiled domain with a Golden Haven Albatross in hand!
His gaze was wild as he looked towards Elder Booma with anger, while Booma himself became utterly happy as he voiced out.
"You succeeded..."
Apexification!
He successfully weathered through it and became an Apex Aeonic Lifeform!
"I succeeded, and I come back to find my reason for everything about to be taken away with a being I do not know- a being that Xiaomi has voiced out she feels no good will towards! What is this?!"
BOOM!
His demeanor was relentless as towards his words, Grand Singularity Elder Zeitgeist lost his smile as he spoke calmly.
"Junior Elder of the Quasarians...I have been polite and understanding so far. So I expect the same treatment from now on as our forces become integrated."
His words released a light of undeniable authority as multiple Dynamis of Extremity buzzed hiddenly within his body!
Yet even towards this low threat...
"Fuck you and your treatment. Get the fuck out of this domain."
His words were blunt as he appeared beside Xiaomi, the Albatross in his hands fading as he erupted with dense lifeforce and grandeur of his new advancement to surge into his daughter's body!
Yet no change occurred as his words only caused Elder Booma to turn pale while Grand Singularity Elder Zeitgeist became utterly cold.
"This is how you treat a savior who simply offered to save the life of your most talented Scion? Hmph, it's good to know the true nature of some of the Quasarians joining us!"
Zeitgeist spoke while moving out, his gaze showing anger that was slowly replaced with coldness as he disappeared.
He didn't go too far away though as his will permeated this region, his Soul buzzing as he pulled out a Communication Medallion and sent his will into it.
"Master, I have located a being with a Pellucid Hyperversal Foundation inclined to RUIN. Extricating her seems like it will be difficult, so I seek your advice to handle it smoothly."
The message traversed across space and time.
Across the veils of the very Havens!
It went through extremely long distances to arrive in a location filled with dense Hyperversal Extremity Authority of multiple concepts, along with the Vacuous Hyperversal Authority as well!
The entire region swirled with such potent grandeur of Hyperversal Extremity Authority that even the most powerful Apex Aeonic Lifeforms would feel suffocated.

In a small area of such space, dazzling preserved corpses of all shapes and sizes could be seen floating freely, many showing dull Extremity Meridians never to light up again as the number easily reached thousands.
And that was just in this small region!

Amidst all of this death, there was a single radiant Lifeform who pulsed with the Hyperversal Extremity Authority in the surroundings as it formed into a massive throne that he sat on, his eyes opening up at this moment as he received the message.
His hair was steeped in darkness as his fair skin illuminated with a stellar glint, his figure gallant and strong as tendrils of authority covered it!
"Another Pellucid Hyperversal Foundation...and this one with a connection to Ruin..."
Among the many Hyperversal Extremity Authorities he had collected, Ruin had yet to be one of them.
The throne of authorities around him pulsed as one golden one flowed out before his eyes.
It was Destiny.
It vibrated with information as he nodded soon after.
"If it mind be troublesome with merely Apex Aeonic Lifeforms...Kabul, go and assist your Junior Brother Zeitgeist in retrieving another Pellucid Hyperversal Foundation for me."
His last sentence boomed out as a command- this being actually sending a Tier 1 Hyperversal Extremity Existence out to secure an Innate foundation for him!
He couldn't make a move himself at this moment as too many Hyperversal Extremities had their eyes on him.
This was because he learned early on that on the path to Extremity...resources eventually thinned.
There was ever expanding chaos. And all Sources of Essences and Authorities simply changed from one form to another in these Havens!
To grow further and exceed all others in such an environment...one had to take from others. They had to devour everything around them to further elevate their grandeur!
And this was his path.
He was well known as the Extremity of Devouring.
The Hyperversal Devourer!
His command was heard as outside this domain of authority, a booming aura of a Tier 1 Hyperversal Extremity followed it and went towards the Aeonic Haven of Dissolution...

Noah's Fantasia Aletheian Chassis arrived before the vast array of clusters of Planes of Existence as the endless blue sheen around him gradually warped until his skin shone with a stellar obsidian light.

He had released a wide area of effect attack the first time he delved into the Abyss of the Abyssal Sanctimonious Lands as a great deal of Quasarians, Noblesse, and Lernaeans had died to him- their Lineages being something assimilated into his Quintessential Hyperversal Emperor Lineage as he could easily pull out their forms!

His skin now shone with a stellar obsidian radiance as if it was made up of countless quasars, seeming like an ancient cosmic lifeform as the air of grandeur and standing of an Emperor still reigned freely.
He received a great deal of information and knowledge on how to get into the heart of the Quasarian Lineage as he made two deals with the Mad Apex Emperor Caesar.

One was that he would save his daughter for the price of the cluster of Planes of Existence he now looked at, and the other was that the two of them would have a match within the coming year as whoever came out on top...would follow the other!

Caesar didn't know what his fate would be before he was whisked away by the Adjudicator of Dissolution as he had given Noah authority and the coordinates to enter the deepest Sacred Quasarian Lands, especially the hidden plane where he instructed him to enter when he had achieved the Extremity Panacea.

As Noah neared, Providence began to buzz within his body as he was wrapped by a clear light of authority- an authority akin to an Elder of the Quasarian Lineage that Caesar had handed off as he freely and without any hindrance headed towards the hidden domain that should hold a dying existence!
