"Little Old Destruction has come to pay his respects to the Adjudicator of this Haven."

His words were reserved as one could see his smile as he said them, the visage of a red robed devilishly handsome existence manifesting with his blazing authority as the veiled visage of the Adjudicator of Dissolution was momentarily forced to focus on him!

Yet even as this being appeared, the figure of Noah's Aletheian Chassis erupted with immense waves of Haki as without even caring about the Esteemed Extremity arriving, his body shot out purposefully and warped across space as it sank into the depths of Haven of Dissolution.

Sensing the rage in his voice, the veiled eyes of the Adjudicator of Dissolution flashed as they simply followed his figure- her will already sensing a violation of the very rules she was upholding in this Haven!
"Oh?"
This scene was caught by the Will of the Hyperversal Extremity of Destruction as he was curious what type of being would be so freely around the Adjudicator of this Haven!
So his Will and Svetlana's Will watched as the Aletheian Chassis pierced across the skies of the Noblesse Domains.

They watched as this body fused into the main one as much to the surprise of the Hyperversal Extremity of Destruction, he recognized the visage of the Quintessential Emperor of Extremity who killed his Squadron of the Scions of Destruction in the Extremity Vein of Dissolution actually fuse into this body as well!
Thereafter, fantastical words that gave them the larger picture erupted out as this being actually went towards two Apex Aeonic Lifeforms with clear hostility.
"Euryale of the Noblesse.
Too cowardly to even face them, you swung a blade to kill my people that haven't undergone Apexification."
"Your death...will not be a quick one."
Shocking words that showed an existence who had yet to undergo Apexification was actually pitting himself against Apex Aeonic Lifeforms!

The eyes of the Hyperversal Extremity of Destruction flashed with profound interest while the veiled figure of the Adjudicator of Dissolution already discerned what had occurred, the coldness from her gaze spreading far as her will already covered the Plane where the dreadful essence of a Dynamis of Extremity pulsed- along with the aura of death of many beings!
Under her watch, an Apex Aeonic Lifeform had shifted to erase lower lifeforms as even now, one such being was seeking retribution on his own.
One of his bodies was right there with her, and yet he hadn't gone to her to impose justice and rectify this mistake.
He wished to take this on with his own hands!
And yet...was it even possible?
He may have an Absolute Dynamis of Extremity and even possibly attained a semblance or the starting point of 'that'.
But would this alone be enough to bridge the unbridgeable gap of the stage of Apex Aeonic Lifeforms?!
With this in mind, the Adjudicator of Dissolution didn't intervene right away as she watched to see how the situation would unfold.

At the same time that this was occurring, a blinking light traversed across the territory above the Domains of the Noblesse as it permeated into the Communication Medallions of all Noblesse Apex Aeonic Lifeforms.
It was a light that stemmed from Richard- this being explaining to the Noblesse Apex Aeonic Lifeforms what Euryale had done as he was unsure of what the fallout would be!

If the rest of the Apex Aeonic Lifeforms of the Noblesse Lineage were involved and knew what was happening, they would at least be able to seek a lesser punishment for Euryale when the Adjudicator of Dissolution intervened.
Thus, a disorderly stage continued to be set as one must not forget the reason why the Hyperversal Extremity of Destruction went forward to grab the attention of the Adjudicator of Dissolution.
It was all so that his Elder Scions of Destruction could finally make a move against their objectives that included Apex Aeonic Lifeforms from the Lernaeans, Quasarians, Noblesse, and Planeswalkers!
Among these targets, Aurelia of the Lernaean Lineage was among them- her main body still moving with Orion and other Apex Aeonic Lifeforms after they splintered from Roan.

Along this procession of events, there was also the fact that from the Quasarian Lineage, the Apex Aeonic Lifeforms of the Aeonic Inheritance of Extremity- the Singularity Overseers, were looking for the entity who had just taken away a lifeform holding an Innate Pellucid Hyperversal Foundation.

Their Apex Aeonic Lifeforms were already spread out across the Quasarian Domains as they were moving even further out to seek their target- and behind them...the Hyperversal Extremity of Devouring had sent forth a Tier 1 Hyperversal Extremity under him to ensure he received what was his!
It was an completely confounding intersection of events as when all of it came together...ah!
[For the next Minute, all Quintessential Hyperversal Values are augmented by a factor of 25!]
One of the benefits of the fusion of the myriad parts of himself was expressed as more followed.
[For the next Minute, Quintessential Hyperversal Soul Values are granted a quasi-quality of the Quintessential Hyperversal Mana Values.]
[No matter how many abilities you utilize, so long as their Soul Value Requirement does not exceed 25 Quintessential Hyperversal Soul Values, they can be cast endlessly.
Your Maximum numerical soul value will not decrease for the next 1 minute!]
A truly ridiculous reality altering authority came down.
An authority originating from the state of fusion Noah currently boasted as it spelled utmost doom for his enemies!
His Quintessential Hyperversal Soul Value was granted a quasi-quality of nothing other than Infinite Mana.
But what did this truly mean?

chapters.title: Chapter 2479 The Wrathful Quintessential Hyperversal Demon Emperor! II
paragraphs: 2479 The Wrathful Quintessential Hyperversal Demon Emperor! II
His Soul Value would not reduce for the next minute!
To visualize this and all the changes the current state of fusion granted, Noah's stat panel quickly flashed before his eyes.
[Name]:: Noah Osmont
[Realm]:: Boundary Expansion(Third Aletheian Haven of Extremity)
[Lineage]:: Quintessential Hyperversal Emperor
[Titles]:: True Emperor of Quintessence, Wrathful Quintessential Hyperversal Demon Emperor, One Who Gazes Upon Hyperversal Authority, Aletheian, Indefatigable, Tyrannical Emperor...
[Quintessential Hyperversal Mana Value]:: Infinite
[Quintessential Hyperversal Vitality Value]:: 3(75)
[Quintessential Hyperversal Soul Value]:: -/1(-/25)
[Quintessential Hyperversal Defense Value]:: 3(75)
[Quintessential Hyperversal Damage Value]:: 1(25)
[Hyperversal Dignity]:: .3
[Hyperversal Mastery]:: .3
[Absolute Hyperversal Authority Resistance]:: 7.5%
[Dynamis of Extremity]:: Indefatigable(Absolute), Aletheian(Absolute)
[Boundaries of Extremity]:: Quintessence, Blood, Manadynamics, Loot, Reality, Dimensions, Anima, Body, Origin, Soul, Genesis, Apocalypse, Prana, Dreams, Avalon...
When he initially viewed his stat panel right after awakening as a Hunter, the value of [Focus] that represented Mana held the dash symbol.

Now, he saw a similar presentation for his Quintessential Hyperversal Soul Value as for the next minute, he could cast any abilities that required 25 Soul Values or below freely as if he held an infinite number of such values!
This was the quasi-quality of Infinite Mana that his Soul Values momentarily attained.
It was a change that made him utterly terrifying as the True scope of what it meant could only be ascertained when he began to run utterly wild!
Then there was the augmented damage and Defense Values that were increased by a factor of 25.
It granted Noah a Quintessential Hyperversal Defense and Vitality Value of 75, along with an Innate Quintessential Hyperversal Barrier of 75!
Now, something had to be made abundantly clear.
After an existence underwent Apexification, the vast majority of average Lifeforms would normally be able to attain the very minimum of 1 Apex Aeonic Damage, Vitality, and Defense Value.

If it was powerful Scions with dozens of Consummate Boundaries, unique existences who had formed Dynamis of Extremity even before Apexification, or those who had established a type of Extremity Foundation would have a value much greater than 1!
But an Apex Aeonic Value of 1 was the starting line as it was in no way the average numerical power of Apex Aeonic Lifeforms.

As they progressed past the 9th Boundary Layer of their concepts and forged Dynamis of Extremity while fortifying their Foundations and Realms, this Value of 1 was quickly exceeded as it was hard to determine the power of an Apex Aeonic Lifeform until they erupted out to display their might- or unless one had an inquisitive Boundary or Dynamis of Extremity that could peer across veils of secrecy!
Noah did not know what Apex Aeonic Values Euryale held.
Whether it was in the tens or hundreds, he did not know!
Yet to him, this didn't matter.
Because he held a state of fusion that allowed his Quintessential Hyperversal Soul Values to mimic his Infinite Mana!
[This state that calls forth one of your strongest states through fusion can only be activated once every three days.]
[After the duration of the state of fusion has ended, you will enter your weakest state with all Values weakened by half for the next day.]
[The breadth of your Soul at the time of fusion will determine the factor that your strength is multiplied by, as well as additional boons and restrictions.]
[The limitation of 1 Minute to maintain the fused state is nearly impossible to exceed.]
HOOONG!

His visage was astounding as the flaming crown above him span with glory and madness, his body entirely becoming encased by an Armament that could only be distinguished as the Hyperversal Demon Emperor's Armament! It pulsed with the grandeur of an Absolute Dynamis of Extremity as Noah's Innate Quintessential Hyperversal Barrier fused into it to further expand its defenses!
The armament extended to his hands as his fingers seemed encased in Crimson, black, and gold crystalline claws that pulsed dangerously.
A crimson aurora of wings stretched out behind him as his vertical slit-like pupils of singularities buzzed with intense pressure that finally caused the laughter from Euryale to cease!
The visage of Richard beside her also became careful as even at such a juncture, Euryale still sneered while voicing out.
"This is the state you've reached after sacrificing all of your soul? Pathetic, it is still below me!"
BOOM!
Halfway through her words, beams of burning darkness erupted as this was a hardened Apex Aeonic Lifeform who moved and killed with precision!
Yet the being that came to collect today was no normal existence.

Apart from the utterly ridiculous fact that his Quintessential Hyperversal Soul Values were momentarily given the quasi-quality of Infinite Mana, he also had a level of access to an authority that very few others held!
"I told you that your death will not be a quick one."
BOOM!
Towards her attack, Noah's visage blinked.
He blinked, and the stretch of reality before him turned dark as Miniature Vacuous Hyperversal Domain was ushered forth.

It unfolded at such a shocking pace and speed as it arrived before the floating figures of Euryale and Richard, his voice buzzing it one last time before this whole region had the targets within it negated of their connection to the very workings of space, time, and reality!
"It will also be a very, very painful one."
1 minute.
It was a short period of time for some, but also an extremely long period of time for those truly powerful.
Trillions of illusory years in a domain filled with Vacuous Hyperversal Authority could be akin to a nanosecond in the outside reality.

Noah's 1 minute of fusion worked with the timing of reality as this battle against an Apex Aeonic Lifeform...could very well be ended within the span of a few seconds, if not much less...so extended as he could overpower her.
So extended as what he had achieved was enough!

A rageful orchestra played in the background as with a resounding authority, the Wrathful Quintessential Hyperversal Demon Emperor bellowed out while plunging into the dark realm that covered everything before him with Vacuous Hyperversal Authority!
It was a shocking scene that caused the Wills of two extremely potent beings to buzz as one gained affirmation, while the other spoke out freely.
"An existence yet to undergo Apexification and he has already achieved 'that'? You've nurtured an intriguing Entity, O Adjudicator of Dissolution!"
